title: Paloma and the Echo
author: Orsen Ashgrove
blurb: Astrid Galloway, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
